label: Joseph Weber
narrative: Joseph Weber of the University of Maryland is printed among the forty-six participants of the January 1957 Conference on the Role of Gravitation in Physics at Chapel Hill, whose report was issued as Wright Air Development Center Technical Report 57-216. He reaches this board as the second name on that document, named independently by a different guest in a different batch of the Danny Jones corpus. Nothing beyond his attendance and his affiliation as of January 1957 has been opened, and his later gravitational-radiation detector work is not asserted here.
